summary: Educational PopIt for kids. Pop bubbles, solve puzzles & learn animal vocabulary
description:
It's time to pop bubbles, solve animal puzzles, and enjoy this fun educational anti-stress game for babies and kids.

Do you love pop it games? Are you a fan of puzzles and jigsaws? Do you adore animals? This educational pop it game that combines all three is perfect for you. The pop it is also perfect for relaxing while enjoying a learning experience. Learn the name of a wide variety of animals today!
Discovering animals from different environments and species has never been so much fun! You've found the perfect word learning game for kids who love to do puzzles and pop balloons or bubbles.

In this Pop It game you'll find different animal puzzles. Join all the pop it pieces to complete the puzzle and then enjoy the satisfying feeling of popping all the bubbles of the pop it anti-stress sensory fidget toy.

This relaxing asmr and educational Pop It game has a simple and intuitive interface, designed especially to make it easy for babies and young children to play. Thanks to the word narration, kids can learn the name of each animal and enrich their vocabulary. This pop it is a great way to learn to associate words with animals and drawings. They can also discover the environment in which the different animals live.

Children can choose the pop it they like the most from several categories or worlds:
🐠 Sea animals: starfish, fish of different colors...
🐒 Jungle animals: monkeys, elephants, leopards, among others.
🐐 Farm animals: the pig, chickens, or sheep.
🦭 Animals that live in the snow: polar bear, walrus and many more!

Discover all the animals that live around the world today!

Features of the bubble popping game:
- Relaxing pop it fidget toy
- Create puzzles and solve jigsaws
- Learn animals from different environments
- Develop skills such as coordination, memory, and attention
- Fun and educational bubble game
- Simulates the effect of popping air bubbles
- Anti-stress and educational toy
- Asmr experience
- Ideal for babies & young children
